title: Session HTTP facade
summary: Lifecycle and transcript HTTP projection over account-scoped Session repositories and governance. Turn execution belongs to the agent/process areas.

replaceability.why: Holds Project integrity or trusted execution authority; replacing it requires Lumeri control.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: GET /sessions
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. May ensure a missing governance ledger and adds active-turn visibility fields; this is not a pure storage read.

operations.name: POST /sessions
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. Checks expected_project_revision, defaulting to current; creates snapshot then budget ledger. No atomic client_op_id Project/result transaction. Optional session_id is accepted; retry without an id creates another Session. Code derives budget from budget_limit_usd, not the documented budget_limit_micros field.

operations.name: GET /sessions/{session_id}
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. Returns resolved Session snapshot.

operations.name: DELETE /sessions/{session_id}
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. Closes snapshot, expires approvals and syncs governance separately. No atomic Project/client_op_id commit or Project revision advance.

operations.name: POST /sessions/{session_id}/resume
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. Resumes under mutation/stop locks, clears stop fence and adds agent visibility. Body is ignored. No atomic Project/client_op_id commit.

operations.name: POST /sessions/{session_id}/fork
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. HTTP 201; same-product snapshot fork then governance fork/sync. Optional requested session_id. No atomic transaction across stores or client_op_id deduplication.

operations.name: POST /sessions/{session_id}/compact
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. Requires summary object and an existing through_event_id. Stores Session compaction, not a Project document/revision commit.

operations.name: GET /sessions/{session_id}/transcript
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. Header cursor takes precedence over query cursor; returns events and next_event_id, retaining supplied cursor when no new events.

invariants.text: Project and Session access is resolved using verified account identity; a path id alone supplies no ownership authority.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: Contract schema checking is available; replacement conformance is not wired at this seam.

known_deviations.text: SessionCreateRequest advertises budget_limit_micros as preferred, but create_session computes the limit only from budget_limit_usd. It also accepts session_id absent from that descriptor.
Session creation/fork/lifecycle spans separate Session and governance writes; it does not expose staged patch plus atomic expected_project_revision/client_op_id result semantics.
